text:
ana_cs: FYI - HelixMed (acct helixmed) just flagged that the enterprise PO credit didn't land on their invoice. they have a contract promo Q4-HELIX-ENT and sales issued a $50,000 credit (PO-87321). customer sees full charge on 2026-03-17 invoice. can we triage and do a manual apply?

mike_sales: confirmed - i added a PO note in SFDC and uploaded the signed addendum. customer expects credit applied this month. PO: PO-87321, amount: $50,000, promo: Q4-HELIX-ENT. cc @julia_revops for ledger stuff.

julia_revops: adding here — we can do a one-time manual adjustment, but need GL code and approver. use adj code `CR-MANUAL-ENT` and tag revenue bucket `Enterprise Promo`. who will create the billing ticket? also need the invoice number (they sent `INV-2026-0317-445`).

ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: sorry, invoice is INV-2026-0317-446. customer pasted it in the thread.

liam_engineer: quick heads-up from infra: billing pipeline has a known edge case where promo codes containing multiple dashes sometimes fail matching during invoice reconciliation (regex split). root cause PR is queued but not rolled. repro steps I used:
```
# repro locally
python tools/billing/reconcile.py --cust helixmed --invoice INV-2026-0317-446 --verbose
# output shows no match for promo string "Q4-HELIX-ENT" (was normalized to "Q4HELIXENT")
```
I can run a targeted manual adjustment script for ops if finance approves.

mike_sales: we need customer-facing ETA. can dev run manual script today?

liam_engineer: yes, can run as soon as billing ticket + approval exist. manual command (ops-only):
```
billing_cli adjust --customer helixmed --invoice INV-2026-0317-446 --amount 50000 --currency USD --reason "PO PO-87321 manual credit per signed addendum" --adj_code CR-MANUAL-ENT --created_by liam_engineer
```
this will create ledger entry + reduce outstanding balance. post-run I'll attach the transaction id.

julia_revops: Authorization from RevOps: approved. I approve GL entry and code `CR-MANUAL-ENT`. Please include ticket link and attach signed PO.

ana_cs: (ana_cs) i've uploaded the signed addendum and added note with invoice and PO.

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BIL-20260318-129 for manual adjustment. Assigned to `billing-ops`. Priority: P1 (customer-facing credit).

mike_sales: looping in @julia_revops and @liam_engineer — customer asked for same-day apply if possible. they said it's blocking their month-end close.

liam_engineer: labeling steps i'll take after ticket created:
1) pull current invoice state and lock invoice (so no concurrent adjustments)
2) run `billing_cli adjust` (command above)
3) run reconciliation job to ensure invoice balance becomes zeroed by credit
4) push transaction id and screenshot to ticket BIL-20260318-129
5) notify customer with confirmation screenshot

ana_cs: thanks. please add the transaction id to the SFDC case and mention PO-87321 so AE knows.

julia_revops: also add retrospective note to prevent duplicate refunds: mark invoice as "credit-applied-manual" and add policy tag.

ops-bot: Deployed billing fix branch `fix/promo-normalization` to staging (not prod). runbook step recommends manual apply until patch is in prod, targeted for 2026-03-20.

liam_engineer: running the manual now (will take ~5–10m). I'll post tx id when done.

liam_engineer: done — transaction id TX-20260318-5582, adjustment posted for $50,000 USD against INV-2026-0317-446. attached screenshot to BIL-20260318-129.

billing-bot: Ticket BIL-20260318-129 updated: status -> RESOLVED. Adjustment TX-20260318-5582 recorded.

ana_cs: passing to customer now, will confirm they see the credit. thanks team :raised_hands:

mike_sales: great work — please leave a short note in SFDC and mark PO-87321 as fulfilled.

ana_cs: customer confirmed via DM: balance updated, invoice credit visible. they appreciate quick turnaround. closing loop. :tada:

julia_revops: recording retrospective: create alert for promo normalization failures and add test case to reconciliation suite. filing a short post-action item.

ana_cs: closing thread. thanks everyone.
